Gather lists what agent dream run would give the next dream, and records
nothing:

  sessions    no longer running, not untracked, not a dream agent's own
              (subagents' sessions go with the session that started them);
              at most 200, oldest first, the rest wait
  friction    this host's open and accepted entries, and closed ones that
              changed since a dream saw them
  handoff     the docs agents' handoff state keys name
  memory      Claude Code's memory/ directory of each session's project
  commit      commits in the repos those sessions ran in, since the last
              committed dream

An item a committed dream reviewed is left out until it changes. With
nothing new, the dream would be quiet: it says why.

Usage:
  agent dream gather [flags]

Examples:
  agent dream gather
  agent dream gather --json

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for gather
      --json   Print as JSON

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
